'''Fiviune''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] that was located in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was considered to be a dead world and its surface consisted of rocky plates and spiky crags. However, there were rumors that Fiviune had once been ruled by an [[Rumored Fiviune civilization|ancient civilization]], which had been destroyed.<ref name="Atlas Extra" />
